source.status: Archived and explicitly untrusted upstream; this record is an adapted exact-grid test on verified current input, not a replay of a validated historical conclusion.

input.pages: LP2-21 through LP2-54 inclusive, separately. Original source rune strings from pages/page_N/runes.txt match each corresponding current Liberpedia text/lp2-N.txt exactly after selecting GP runes; verify this before scoring.
input.rune_values: Source GP29 order. Exclude separators from cipher; retain page boundaries; key and stream positions start at zero on each page.
input.primes: Ascending ordinary primes from source sieve through 100000. The required first 2050 primes fit that bound.

grid.keywords: Exactly the 16 named, source-specified numeric GP29 arrays in KEYWORDS, including DEOR. No inferred spellings or added keys.
grid.second_streams: The 102 source streams: 50 consecutive prime-totient residues, 50 consecutive prime residues, one cumulative prime-totient residue, one linear index mod 29, one Fibonacci stream mod 29; each restarts per page.
grid.signs: Two keyword signs times two second-stream signs. Decode P_i=(C_i ± K_(i mod length) ± S_i) mod 29. All signs are source settings; no extra Vigenere phase.
grid.score: Source IoC normalized by uniform expectation 1/29. Report per-page maxima, source-threshold hits at IoC>1.4, whole-grid maximum, singleton I/A count, and best decoded prefix only as a diagnostic, not a reading.
grid.source_gate: IoC>1.4 is a candidate screen, not proof of English. A missing hit cannot exclude all layered ciphers.

controls.known_reading: Encrypt one complete established reading with a fixed source keyword, stream and two signs, then require exact full recovery in the same grid and record whether IoC>1.4 captures it.
controls.permutation: 49 seeded page-wise GP29 shuffles, each preserving the page's individual rune histogram. Repeat the entire 221952-cell selection on each shuffled corpus and compare maximum IoC and source-threshold hit counts. Seed 20261023. This is a diagnostic for search selection, not a plaintext or cipher model.
controls.independence: Compare fixed source keyword/stream/sign candidates to a separate scalar implementation and independently verify original/site input equality.

limitations: A two-layer additive model only. The old source script's archived status and path bug mean its historical output is not assumed reliable. Flat IoC is not a language detector; the permutation comparison is conditional on preserved page histograms and this finite grid. No alternate key phase, word reset, transposition, adaptive keyword, or extra layer is tested.
